fusions.name: Ribbon Flourish
fusions.desc: Sweeps the lash through a wide cone that deals 3 damage to everything within 3 tiles, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Linen
fusions.desc: Snaps the lash at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strip Bandage
fusions.desc: Binds your wounds and restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Plaited Jerkin
fusions.desc: Conjures a jerkin plaited from lash-thongs: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 10.
